pages.title: Another Yesterday
pages.text: Compare an ancient landscape with the first epoch.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Follow the Journey Guide’s portal route. Keep a return path and inspect the different land and sea life rather than collecting every creature.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Explore Paleogene, Neogene and Pleistocene eras. Formations are biome-like regions within each dimension. Content scope is three dimensions, not two.
